hydro.sourceNote: Hydro-Québec open data, sources of electricity produced in Quebec (production.json, hydraulique MW), 27 hourly readings 2026-11-17T05:30:00.000Z to 2026-11-18T07:30:00.000Z. Generation measured. Waste unpublished — Hydro-Québec publishes no hourly spill-energy series; spilled flows (m³/s) in its hydrometric dataset are not energy. Replaces the former ~0.3 TWh/yr modelled surplus anchor, which had no published source. Missing ≠ zero. Not T1a.
